description: He wears a long navy blue wool-like coat, open at the front over a cream linen-like long shirt. Fine gold woven borders cover the coat front, cuffs and hem. The shirt has blue geometric embroidery framing its neckline and lower hem. A dark brown decorated belt with round metal fittings circles the waist. Two circular clasps sit at the upper coat front. Full sleeves cover the arms, with white underlayer cuffs visible at the wrists. Dark brown trousers tuck into tall brown leather boots. The clothes are opaque, structured and richly made without ceremonial regalia. No headgear or weapon appears; exact fibers are uncertain.
